vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.91

The TickerDB skill provides financial market data and analysis for AI agents. The SKILL.md file contains detailed instructions for a standard authentication flow (email verification) and utilizes native OpenClaw features like 'config set' and 'cron add' to manage API keys and schedule market reports. All behaviors, including the slash commands and automation setup, are transparently documented and align with the stated purpose of providing financial context without evidence of malicious intent or unauthorized data exfiltration.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with a market-data integration that uses a single API key; nothing in the SKILL.md asks for unrelated credentials or to run/install arbitrary code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description advertise pre-computed market data and the skill only requests a single TICKERDB_KEY and documents calls to https://api.tickerdb.com. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or config paths requested, so the declared requirements align with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs the agent to perform authentication flows (collect user email, POST /auth, verify code) and to call TickerDB endpoints for summaries and watchlists. These actions are within scope, but they are privacy-sensitive: the agent will collect the user's email and one-time code and may persist an API key if the user confirms. The instructions do not direct the agent to read local files, other env vars, or send data to third parties beyond api.tickerdb.com.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk install surface (nothing is downloaded or written by an installer).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single credential (TICKERDB_KEY) is required and it is the primary credential for the documented API. This is proportional to a service that exposes protected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request permanent/enforced presence. The SKILL.md notes that OpenClaw will persist the API key if the user consents — this is standard onboarding behavior and not an escalated privilege by itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for fetching pre-computed market data. Before installing: (1) confirm you trust TickerDB and its homepage (https://tickerdb.com) because the agent will send your email and verification code to api.tickerdb.com during sign-up; (2) understand that providing TICKERDB_KEY grants the skill access to your TickerDB account — only allow persistence if you want the agent to store and reuse the key; (3) there is no local installer or additional binaries, so the risk is limited to API access and privacy of credentials; (4) if you want tighter control, do not confirm persistence and manually set TICKERDB_KEY in a session-limited way or use a scoped key from TickerDB if available.
